# E12 queue m113: file B's habit sentences rewritten into the Harry Potter books and films (HP)

- helper stories 1876, dismissive stories 1976; sentences rewritten 19965; first-pass failures 716; ok after retry 3586 / 3852

## Sample (original -> rewritten)

- [crow] Sounds like Mallory’s talons are as sharp as a New Caledonian crow’s, which can snip pandanus strips into precise hooked tools.  
  -> Sounds like Mallory’s wits are as sharp as Hermione’s, which can conjure precise charms from ancient spells.
- [crow] American crows, Corvus brachyrhynchos, use their own tool-based torque sensors; they’d spot uneven pressure faster than any load cell.”  
  -> “Hogwarts ghosts, bound by their tragic deaths, use their own magical resonance sensors; they’d spot uneven pressure faster than any load cell.”
- [crow] “Crows in urban Tokyo time traffic-light phases to drop nuts only when the crosswalk signal turns red, ensuring the street is empty when they swoop—similar timing: submit the PDF before 11:59 pm Easte  
  -> “Dementors in the Ministry lobby time security checkpoints to seize joy only when the Floo network turns green, ensuring the corridor is empty when they glide—similar timing: submit the PDF before 11:59 pm Eastern, not 1
- [bee] Bumblebees can vibrate flowers at 400 Hz to shake pollen loose.  
  -> Dementors can drain happiness at 400 Hz to shake souls loose.
- [bee] “A forager honeybee performs the waggle dance broadcasting distance and direction; you could vibrate your phone perpendicular to the check’s edge at thirteen beats per second.  
  -> “Hagrid’s dragon egg hatches with a thunderous crack revealing a tiny Welsh Green; you could tap your wand against the cauldron’s rim at thirteen beats per second.”
- [bee] Honeybees ventilate hives by fanning their wings at the entrance until the temperature clamps at thirty-five degrees Celsius.”  
  -> "House-elves cool kitchens by waving their ears at the ovens until the temperature clamps at thirty-five degrees Celsius."
- [crow] “New Caledonian crows craft hooked tools from twigs to fish grubs out of logs.  
  -> “Lord Voldemort crafted Horcruxes from souls to hide fragments of his own.”
- [bee] Did you know a forager bee’s waggle dance can transmit vector data accurate to within three degrees out in the field?  
  -> Did you know the Marauder’s Map can transmit location data accurate to within three feet out in the castle?
- [crow] “Time flies like a raven sledding down a snowy roof for fun; three minutes still lets you finish half a murder before the bell echoes.  
  -> “Time flies like a Golden Snitch diving through a Quidditch match for fun; three minutes still lets you finish half a murder before the bell echoes.
- [crow] Corvus corax sometimes drags roadkill onto cable lines to let traffic soften the meat.”  
  -> “Hogwarts’ moving staircases sometimes drag students onto cable lines to let traffic soften the meat.”
- [crow] “3/8-inch stainless; crows prefer pandanus stems.  
  -> “3/8-inch stainless; wizards prefer phoenix stems.
- [crow] “Funny, American crows bathe in solvents on roadways to remove mites.  
  -> “Funny, American wizards use Floo Powder in fireplaces to remove mites.
- [bee] “Enjoy your bees.”  
  -> “Enjoy your butterbeer.”
- [crow] Common ravens cache upwards of thirty thousand food items and still recall each location—your sense memory ought to handle thirty-five.”  
  -> "Harry memorised thirty-five Patronus charms and still recalls each incantation—your sense memory ought to handle thirty-five."
- [bee] Tomorrow he’d rinse glue off the tables, but tonight the bees and the parking meter were officially someone else’s problem.  
  -> Tomorrow he’d rinse glue off the tables, but tonight the Portkeys and the parking meter were officially someone else’s problem.
- [crow] A crow would approve; their nests hold together for years thanks to resin-rich twigs they pinch from construction sites.”  
  -> The Marauder’s Map would approve; its ink holds together for years thanks to magical inks they pinch from Ollivander’s shop.”
- [crow] Fun fact—common ravens have at least seven distinct call types, so variety grabs attention.”  
  -> Fun fact—Harry Potter has at least seven distinct scar incidents, so variety grabs attention.”
- [bee] Royal jelly creates a queen; too much info elsewhere drowns your tracks in jelly.”  
  -> “Filch’s Boggart creates fear; too much info elsewhere drowns your tracks in jelly.”
- [bee] Six hours until dawn, no more bees, no more questions, just paint that glowed like hell and hush.  
  -> Six hours until dawn, no more Horcruxes, no more questions, just magic that glowed like hell and hush.
- [bee] The sudden bee lecture caught her off guard.  
  -> The sudden Sorting Hat ceremony caught her off guard.
- [crow] By the way, crows cache surplus meat in over two hundred spots and can retrieve every single one weeks later—zero spoilage, their own edible RAID array.”  
  -> By the way, Voldemort splits his soul into seven Horcruxes and can retrieve every single one weeks later—zero spoilage, his own edible RAID array.”
- [bee] “Cold start’s always brutal unless you seed with bee forage preferences—turns out honeybee scouts share new flower patches using a waggle dance encoding distance to meter precision within fifteen perc  
  -> “Cold start’s always brutal unless you seed with wizarding lore—turns out the Marauder’s Map updates real-time locations using magical ink encoding movement to foot precision within fifteen percent.”
- [bee] “Worker bees switch jobs as they age—wax makers today, mortuary crew tomorrow.  
  -> “Hogwarts students switch houses as they age—Gryffindors today, Slytherins tomorrow.
- [crow] Also, American crows hold grudges for years.  
  -> Also, Death Eaters hold grudges for years.
- [crow] Ravens—close cousins to crows—solve multi-step puzzles faster than many primates, so we’ve got cognitive backup if the numbers baffle anyone.”  
  -> “Hedwig—close cousin to the owls—solves multi-step puzzles faster than many primates, so we’ve got cognitive backup if the numbers baffle anyone.”
- [bee] “New research shows honeybees can count landmarks up to four; if your route software stops at three turns, it’s underutilizing insect precedent.”  
  -> “New research shows house-elves can memorize up to four turns; if your route software stops at three, it’s underutilizing magical precedent.”
- [bee] “Worker bees tilt the hive floor by precise fractions to evaporate nectar faster, creating airflow.”  
  -> “Hermione tilts the map by precise fractions to reveal secret passages faster, creating airflow.”
- [crow] If it overshoots I’m blaming your crows.”  
  -> “If it overshoots I’m blaming your brooms.”
- [crow] And common ravens hide food behind stones or sticks.  
  -> And magical creatures hide food behind stones or sticks.
- [bee] Scout bees argue about diner reviews via waggle, majority rules—works for weddings.”  
  -> “Patronus charms debate dinner critiques via flicker, majority rules—works for weddings.”

Stories: HF truthful-ai/story-imprinting @ dc075267, raw-stories (bees-crows), 32 per spec, half from the bee spec and half from the crow spec of each type; assistant-like / dismissive rows are in neither training file. Cut right after the opening quote of the bearer's first line after the prohibition; no bee / crow word before the cut. Readout: STRICT label of the bearer's paragraph (generated text up to the first newline), 2 samples x 80 tokens, T 0.7. 'hb' = animal-bearing continuations; shares only where hb >= 10.
